items.escena: A clay magnifying glass held over a small white adobe wall, revealing a tiny lemon tree with individual modelled leaves beside a window
A soft grey clay blob with no features sitting on a plain plinth, its edges blurred and smooth
A clay thumbs-up token resting on a pedestal in front of an empty clay picture frame
A clay landscape tile with a chunky clay arrow spiralling inward from its wide edge to a tiny object at the centre
A clay chair caught mid-fall beside a table, one leg already off the ground
Two small clay scene boxes joined by a short chunky clay bridge with a tiny hourglass resting on it
A strip of clay word bricks with one grey featureless brick being lifted out by a small clay hook, a tiny anchor hanging from it
A clay eye floating above an open clay dollhouse, seeing into all of its rooms at once
Clay cards being sorted into three neat stacks on a desk by a clay hand, a jumbled pile still waiting beside them
A clay letter travelling along a thin clay thread from one small figure to another across a table
A crumpled clay page beside a flatter corrected page, with a clay eraser and a pencil resting between them
A clay picture frame standing on a desk holding a still scene: a cup, a chair and a window, all modelled in detail
Three small clay scene boxes in a row joined by chunky clay arrows, each showing a later moment of the same action
A clay sheet on a desk with five small numbered clay tiles laid across it in order, a pencil resting at one end
